transcript: I don't know about you, but I miss the era of great New York City ROM-coms Luckily, two strangers carry A cake across New York is bringing it back. I saw this in London last summer and I loved it. So obviously we had to celebrate that it's now in New York with Magnolia cake and cocktails Red Eye Grill. And the coolest customizable New York City themed mess hall truck stop hats. I could not get over this. We got to design it ourselves and pick out our own patches. I just thought it was so cute. And then I ate a lot of fortune cookies. If you know you know two strangers is the story of two strangers. One's a Brit, one's a New Yorker, and they have the ultimate unexpected New York City adventure. It's part buddy comedy, part holiday romance and has some of my favorite songs of this entire Broadway season. It's deeply funny and just New York. Sam Tutty who came from London with the show is so absurdly charming. Just goofy and warm and open And Christiani Pitts is dynamic on stage you cannot look away from her. And the two of them together just have incredible chemistry. You will fall in love with them It is impossible not to. If you're looking for one show to brighten up this cold, dark winter this is it. Bring your partner, your friends, your family. I'd recommend it for everybody. I love New York and I love shows that love New York. So two strangers carry a cake across New York definitely has my heart.
